The '''Z-95t Headhunter''' was a variant of the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] designed by [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]]. Unlike the standard headhunter, it was equipped with a class 3 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and lacked concussion missile launchers.

A unit of Z-95t Headhunters was operationally assigned to provide close air support to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine's]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]]. At least one of the ships was also equipped with an advanced [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] suite to monitor [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] activity during commando actions.
